title: Web app manifest and icons
goal: The client can be installed as an app
acceptance: A manifest (name, short name, icons from the favicon design, theme colours from STYLE-GUIDE tokens, standalone, start URL /)
The build serves it; a client spec or build check finds it
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
